description: Validate a 12-character ISIN (ISO 6166) via its Luhn-style mod-10 check digit. The 2-letter country code and 9-character alphanumeric security identifier are transliterated (A=10 ... Z=35) into a numeric string before the Luhn algorithm is applied, the same way credit card numbers are checksummed.

isin.description: The 12-character ISIN, with or without spaces

name: validate_isin
